sources.title: ohjoonhee/Qwen3.5-9B-VK-OPD-think · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The evaluation used thinking on with the model-card sampling (temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, presence penalty 1.5), 1 sample, up to 8,192 tokens, and the prompt ending "Answer the question using a single word or phrase." The answer is the text after </think>. Grading is an exact rule match first, then Qwen3.5-27B as the judge.
